name: Field Display Kit
description: Adds per-display fine-tuning of field output (label text/tag, field and item wrapper elements, classes, attributes, item linking, and a delimiter) via field formatter third-party settings and an FDK field.html.twig override.

suggests.drupal/token: Enables token tree links in the FDK settings form and token replacement in attribute values and item link hrefs.

project_description: The Field Display Kit (FDK) module adds fine-grained control over how any field is rendered, layered on top of core's Manage display. When enabled it exposes an extra "Field Display Kit Settings" section on the formatter settings of every field on every entity, stored as field-formatter third-party settings (config schema type field.formatter.third_party.fdk). Per display / view mode you can: override the field label text; change the label, field-wrapper, and per-item-wrapper HTML element (a fixed select list plus a validated custom tag); add free-form CSS classes and attribute lines (attribute|value, with token support when the Token module is present); turn any field item into a link with a token-aware href; force the field wrapper even for single-value fields; and add a comma delimiter with an optional "and" before the last item. FDK ships its own field.html.twig and swaps it in for core's copy via hook_theme_registry_alter (only when the field template still comes from core, so real theme overrides win). Because of that, a theme that overrides field.html.twig must base its override on FDK's template; the module provides a report at /admin/reports/fdk (permission administer site configuration) that scans all active themes' field templates and lists any that are missing FDK's variables (field_wrapper_tag, label_tag, field_item_wrapper_tag). The module has no settings form, no permissions, no entities, and no Drush commands; its only route is the read-only compatibility report.
